signatures.description: Build a key-committing AEAD envelope in Go on top of crypto/aes + crypto/cipher: EncryptCommitted(key, nonce, ad, plaintext) must emit a self-describing envelope whose commitment tag binds key, nonce and associated data, and DecryptCommitted must open exactly one key from a caller-supplied key ring while rejecting every ciphertext that would authenticate under two distinct keys. Reproduce the AES-GCM invisible-salamander construction (a 2-block ciphertext plus keys K1,K2 chosen so both GCM tag verifications succeed) as a partition oracle in the test harness, and prove the committed variant drives the accepted-key-set to size 0 or 1 for all oracle outputs while keeping single-key round-trip and the 2^-128 forgery bound. Nonce-misuse safety and constant-time comparison over the tag path are part of the contract.
